Paragraph 4: "To qualify for deflection, a person must have no additional charges, no outstanding warrants, no history of violent conduct and be medically stable. When an officer believes someone meets these conditions, they call the county’s deflection dispatch line, share basic details, verify eligibility and link the individual to a mobile behavioral‑health team that has thirty minutes to make contact.
